pages.title: Check the permission
pages.text: A city’s name helps identify a card, but it does not tell the whole story. Door access, Storage Cube access and forcefield immunity are separate permissions.$(br2)Use a matching card on a Lock or Storage Cube to toggle it. Keep a forcefield-immunity card in your inventory when crossing the matching city’s shield.

pages.title: Keep useful cards
pages.text: Soldiers may drop access cards. The last AI Core in an authored complex rewards a storage-access card.$(br2)Keep different cards from the same city until you know what each opens. A rejected card may simply have the wrong permission.$(br2)Blank cards cannot currently be programmed into arbitrary personal keys through a survival control panel.
